name: Wind Turbine Fault Detection and Fault Tolerant Control Benchmark Challenge
description: Evaluates algorithms for fault detection and fault-tolerant control of wind turbines using standardized datasets and/or simulator-based challenge scenarios to compare detection and control performance.
evaluation_method: F1 / detection latency and control-performance metrics (e.g., tracking error, stability margins)
general_score_metric: F1 (for detection) plus control performance metrics (e.g., tracking error) for control tasks
reputation: A known academic challenge in the wind-energy and control-systems research communities, cited in research on fault detection and fault-tolerant control but not a mainstream ML benchmark.
notes: Often simulator-based or using specialized datasets; performance depends heavily on simulator fidelity and chosen metrics. Non-LLM benchmark; limited broad benchmark tooling and potential small-sample or scenario-specific overfitting.
